body: There is a synchronization issue between Google Contacts and Apple Calendar. Birthdays synced from Google Contacts are sometimes displayed on the wrong date in Apple Calendar. Apple Calendar should preserve the original dates without changing or duplicating birthday events.

title: Why days are missing in October 1582 (Historical fact)
body:
While checking October 1582, I noticed that dates from Oct 5 to Oct 14 are missing.
After researching, I learned this is historically accurate due to the Gregorian calendar reform in 1582, when 10 days were skipped to correct calendar drift.
The calendar correctly jumps from Oct 4 to Oct 15, which confirms the app follows real historical calendar transitions.
Great attention to historical accuracy 👍

title: Inconsistency in the Calendar application…
body:
I have identified an inconsistency in the Calendar application when viewing October 1582. In the detailed month view, the calendar correctly reflects the Gregorian reform, where October 4 is immediately followed by October 15. However, in the year overview view, October is displayed as a continuous sequence (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, etc.) without accounting for the missing dates.

This discrepancy presents conflicting information within the same application and may cause confusion for users referencing historical dates. I recommend aligning both views to consistently represent the Gregorian calendar transition to ensure historical accuracy and coherence across all display modes.

title: Feedback about ‘Alert’ section of Calendar
body:
Apple’s Calendar is a great App with many good functionalities & the ‘Custom’ feature of setting the frequency of a reminder is really amazing.

My only complaint with this is App is in the ‘Alert’ section, while setting any Calendar event.
Why do you have an option called ‘None’ in the Alert section?
I mean who would want to set up an event or reminder and not set up an Alert for it? What would be the point of setting up the event, if it is simply there in your calendar & you are not reminded of it?

And the worst part is that, this ‘None’ option is selected by default & one needs to change it to something else, in order to get the reminder for any event.
Please change the default from ‘None’ to at-least ‘At time of event’.
Many a times, if a person forgets to change the ‘None’ option to something else, he/she would not get the reminder at all & may miss out on some very urgent, important and time-oriented activity/task, for which they had set the reminder in the first place.

I don’t know what is the Developer’s logic behind putting this ‘None’ option & making it the default one but if feasible, please get rid of this option and if you somehow want to keep it, kindly change the default from ‘None’ to something else, that would make the reminders pop-up for all Calendar Events.

Hope I was able to explain the predicament well. Kindly do the needful in your next update. Will look forward to it. Thanks !
